# Copyright Registration Guidance — Works Containing Material Generated by Artificial Intelligence

## Bibliographic Metadata

- Author or issuing body: United States Copyright Office, Library of Congress
- Publication date: 2023-03-16
- Source type: Federal Register statement of policy (37 C.F.R. Part 202)
- URL: https://www.copyright.gov/ai/ai_policy_guidance.pdf
- Archive URL: None recorded

## Reliability Notes

Official Copyright Office policy statement published at 88 Fed. Reg. 16190. Agency guidance on registration practice, not a judicial holding. The Office later issued a January 2025 copyrightability report that elaborates the same human-authorship framework.
